children: XBP Global completed a set of financing agreements to raise approximately $6.05 million through a private placement of 2,275,245 common shares at a weighted price of about $2.66 per share. Accredited investors, including HCI and funds managed by Avenue, participated alongside certain executives, with portions priced at $2.83 and $2.55. In connection with the deal, the company granted resale registration rights and secured short-term lock-ups from insiders to support orderly trading. Closing is expected on or before September 15, 2026, subject to customary conditions.
